review_body: Crisp and refreshing. The black cherry flavour is perfectly balanced — not too sweet.
Mango is subtle and tropical. Great poolside drink.
Super clean lemon flavour. Probably the best RTD for the price in Ontario.
Classic lime seltzer done right. Goes down too easy.
A bit sweet for me but solid if you like lemonade.
Palm Bay hits different at a cottage. Key lime cherry is the move.
Strongbow Gold Apple is the benchmark for Ontario cider. Crisp dry finish.
Rekorderlig is sweeter than I prefer but the strawberry lime combo is undeniably delicious.
Kopparberg mixed fruit is fruity but not cloying. Good cider for the price.
Somersby is serviceable but lacks depth compared to European imports.
Nude grapefruit is underrated. Clean spirit base with real citrus bite.
Peach tea Nude is unique — actually tastes like iced tea with a kick.
NÜTRL grapefruit competes with Nude. Slightly more carbonation which I prefer.
NÜTRL raspberry is a bit artificial tasting vs the grapefruit version.
Ace Hill Lemon is the Ontario local hero. Support local.
Watermelon Ace Hill is great for summer patios.
Lime version is solid too. Consistent quality across the Ace Hill lineup.
Smirnoff Ice is too sweet. More like a pop than a real drink.
Bud Light Clamato Caesar hits different after a long week.
The craft Caesar is elevated — more complex spice profile.
Classic Mott's Caesar Original. The original and still great.
Extra spicy is the way to go if you can handle heat.
Absolut Espresso Martini in a can is legitimately good. Saved me $20 at a bar.
Vodka Mojito from Absolut is fresh and minty. Perfect summer RTD.
Ocean Spray collab is decent but I prefer the pure vodka sodas.
Vizzy blueberry pomegranate is a nice change from the usual suspects.
Pineapple mango Vizzy is tropical perfection. My new summer staple.
Truly Wild Berry is fine but not as clean as White Claw.
Truly Lemonade is bold and tangy. Good if you want more flavour punch.
Cottage Springs Lemon is the best value vodka soda in Ontario.
Raspberry Cottage Springs is close second. Both are excellent for the price.
Gin and Soda Cucumber is sophisticated. Great for gin lovers on a budget.
White Claw Black Cherry is a classic for a reason.
White Claw Raspberry might be their best flavour overall.
Palm Bay Mango Strawberry is ridiculously fruity — in a good way.
Strongbow Dark Fruit has an interesting berry-forward character.
Rekorderlig Mango Raspberry is my favourite premium cider. So unique.
Kopparberg Strawberry Lime is very sweet — dessert in a can.
Somersby Blackberry is okay but the apple version is better.
The -196 Lemon is elite. Nothing else at this price point competes.
Ace Hill Lemon is second place for lemon RTDs after -196.
Nude Grapefruit is a great late night option.
NÜTRL Watermelon is summer in a can. Buy a case.
Creemore Radler is a bit too mellow for me but solid for a session drink.
Mike's Hard Black Cherry Lemonade is nostalgic and still hits.
Mike's Hard Watermelon is too sweet but fine for a casual Friday.
Smirnoff Ice Screwdriver tastes like orange pop.
Palm Bay Tropical Lime is the ultimate dock drink.
Palm Bay Pineapple Coconut is very tropical — great for a themed party.
Nude Raspberry Lemonade is dangerously drinkable. Watch out.
